title: CxMP: A Linguistic Minimal-Pair Benchmark for Evaluating Constructional Understanding in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on grammatical constructions using common nouns versus controlled proper names and pseudowords to detect reliance on statistical word associations rather than underlying semantic meaning.

Measuring the absolute difference in mean scores between original sentences and switched-entity sentences to quantify reliance on shallow surface heuristics, such as consistently selecting the first or nearest noun.
